Notes: First Jews settled in Ivanovo during the 1620s (Year of Data is start of decade)
1765 census: Jews living in and near the town
German occupation 25 June 1941; on 5 August an SS cavalry unit murdered around 420 Jewish men (event count)
Ghetto established on Passover eve 1942; liquidated 24 September 1942 when most Jews were massacred; about 100 survived (event counts)
No Jews were living in Ivanovo after World War II (year approximate)
SS Cavalry Brigade murdered about 380-800 Jewish men and boys in early August 1941; ghetto liquidated end of September 1942 with at least 2000 residents murdered near Rudzk (death tolls)
